a.title: Uber Eats starts drone deliveries in Texas

b.lede: Uber Eats is officially launching drone delivery in partnership with Zipline starting Tuesday. The initial rollout begins in the Houston suburb of Spring, Texas, with Dallas next in line and dozens of additional US cities planned.
